summary: EarthTrend Detective by Team AKT.AYUSH is an advanced interactive web application developed for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge (Be An Earth System Trend Detective!). It empowers researchers, educators, and citizens to seamlessly select Earth science mission variables (MODIS, Gpm, GLDAS, OMI, MERRA-2), visualize 10-year multi-regional trends, and evaluate statistical significance using rigorous Mann-Kendall p-values and rate-of-change metrics. By bridging raw NASA satellite datasets with intuitive, real-time visual analytics, EarthTrend Detective transforms complex environmental data into clear insights on what is changing, where, how much, and if those changes are statistically significant.
details: EarthTrend Detective provides a unified, interactive interface to explore global environmental shifts. Users select an Earth science variable—such as Land Surface Temperature (MODIS), Precipitation Rate (GPM), Soil Moisture Index (GLDAS), Total Ozone Column (OMI), or Evapotranspiration (MERRA-2)—and pair it with critical global regions (Amazon Basin, Arctic Circle, Gangetic Plains, Sahara Desert, Australian Outback). The platform instantly renders 10-year time-series charts and executes statistical analyzers to calculate the Rate of Change, run Mann-Kendall significance tests (p-values), and deliver an automated verdict distinguishing genuine directional trends from natural climatic noise.
